title: Ọlọ́run àwámárìdì!
review_notes: Photo of page 5 provides stanzas 3–4, completing the printed hymn. Stanzas 1–2 and hand-copied English are drafts; all tone marks need final checking.
english_source: Original explanatory translation from visible Yoruba lines
verses: Ta ló yẹ ká f'ọkàn wa fún?
Ta ló yẹ ká tún fẹ́ràn?
Ta ló yẹ ká fi ọkàn wa
Ògo tí ẹ̀dá kò lè wò
Ń ṣàn sórí iṣẹ́ Rẹ gbogbo
Kín l'ohun tí wọ ṣe àìní?
Kín la lè fi tẹ́ Ọ l'ọ́run?
Pé kí n lè f'ọkàn mi fún Ọ
Ìwọ tí ìtẹ́ Rẹ ń bẹ l'ókè
Ó ń pàṣẹ lórí gbogbo wọn
Títí n ó fi bá Ọ jọba
verses_en: O God beyond our searching!
To whom should we give our hearts?
Whom else should we love so dearly?
Jesus, beloved of our souls,
To whom should we give our hearts
And all our strength in love?
The glory of the Lord shines bright,
A splendour no creature can behold;
Even the angels veil their faces,
Yet still His goodness flows like a river
Over all the works of His hands.
You are the fountain of all blessings
What could You ever need?
What gift could we lay before You?
Yet still, You ask for one thing:
That I might give my heart to You
It is all that You require
Your throne is established above
Your kingdom shall never end
Your rule extends over all creation
Yet You have come to seek me
To guide my path continually
Until I reign with You at last
